newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian M2 money supply rises 1.3 pct in August.
newsitem.headline: Russian M2 money supply rises 1.3 pct in August.

text.p: Russian M2 money supply rose 1.3 percent in August after a 1.9 percent rise in July, the central bank said on Monday.
RUSSIAN MONEY SUPPLY Sept 1 Aug 1 Jan 1
NOTES - Volumes in trillion roubles. Monthly figures expressed as totals on first day of following month. Figures for 1995 not available.
The central bank said M2 money supply at the beginning of September was 57.8 percent higher than a year earlier, compared with a 37.1 percent rise in consumer prices over the same period.
